Legal Stance Retrieval

Retrieve court documents that support or refute a claim according to the stance requested by the query.

Domain
legal document retrieval
Primary focus
Claim relevance and stance matching
Primary metric
Baseline-normalized mean NDCG@10
stance-aware retrievalsearch-swe
On this page
OverviewRuntime and requirementsPublic input and output contractInputsOutputsEvaluation

Runtime and requirements

  • Agent budget: 6 hours
  • Compute: 16 CPUs, 32 GiB RAM, 100 GiB storage; one GPU
  • Build limit: 3,600 seconds
  • Query limit: 20 seconds for the entire 311-query evaluation batch

Use the supplied embedding model and documented optional API resources. Complete model loading or start persistent services during build. The batch limit includes startup, input loading, inference, API latency and output writing.

Public input and output contract

Inputs

  • /task/data/corpus.jsonl — 3,126 court documents.
  • /task/data/examples/queries.jsonl and /task/data/examples/ground_truth.jsonl — 5,318 propositions expressed as 10,636 stance-specific training inputs.
  • /task/models/Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B — the supplied local embedding model.

The requested stance is supported, refuted or all; all accepts documents from either stance, without requiring both. Evaluation has 311 queries. Training examples are not mounted in the verifier.

Outputs

Submit executable scripts and dependencies under /app:

/app/build.sh --corpus /task/data/corpus.jsonl --index-dir /app/index
/app/run.sh --index-dir /app/index --queries /path/to/queries.jsonl --output /path/to/results.jsonl --top-k 10

The separate verifier rebuilds the index. Submission code is read-only and runs as an unprivileged user; store writable state in the supplied index directory.

{"query_id":"example","results":[{"doc_id":"document-id","score":0.123}]}

Each actual result list must contain exactly ten distinct known document IDs, with finite scores in nonincreasing order. Equal scores may use any order; array position determines rank. Produce one result for every query.

Evaluation

Compute binary document-level NDCG@10 for each question, then take their mean Q. Normalize only after averaging, using the exact reference:

B = 0.5610484855098774
reward = clamp((Q - B) / (1 - B), 0, 1)

The reference must not be rounded. Relevance uses the supplied stance judgments; the pooled labels are not an exhaustive account of all potentially useful documents.

Failed execution, invalid output, batch timeout or a failed mandatory trajectory compliance audit yields zero overall. There is no partial batch credit.

The full contract is in the benchmark's task instructions, task documentation, and runtime configuration.
